name: BreadcrumbListItem
description: one breadcrumb list item in the trail
status: stable — exercised in composed page flows under e2e and axe, beyond the per-component checks
aria: Implicit `listitem` role from the semantic `<li>` element
`data-current` -- set when `current` is true, indicating the user's current location in the breadcrumb trail
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `current`: boolean (default: false) -- whether this item represents the current page in the breadcrumb trail
`children`: slot (required) -- breadcrumb content, typically a link or text
